fieldNotes.variantOf: id of the root identity when this entry is a derivation (same engine, only ground / palette / fonts change), else null. A root lists its derivations in variants and what is shared / what varies in variantAxis. Derivations stay ranked, right after their root; counts.identities counts roots only, counts.declinations counts every entry. curation.deliberateSiblings = derivations of the same root, deliberately close and therefore not listed in confusableWith. A new identity that reuses an existing engine and only changes ground / palette / fonts must be registered as a derivation, not as a new identity
fieldNotes.status: selected = kept in Phase 1; rehabilitated = set aside in Phase 1 only to avoid topic overlap with a neighbour, then produced on request with the same rules and evidence level; added = added after the campaign: (a) the cut-paper identity from the StudioGabarit template, papier-decoupe, and its 3 derivations (atelier-papier, carnet-archives, cabinet-curiosites), rendered by the shared Python engine out/shared/papier-moteur/, appended after the ranked identities and not part of the ranking or the blind visual judge; (b) lot 2 of the identity factory (trait-continu, carte-meteo, 2026-11-05: scouting + adversarial challenge + studio + review), ranked with the others, blind visual judge on 8 identities (lot 2 + 6 neighbours, 8/8 pure groups, out/report/notes/revue-2026-11-05.md), voice-over Gemini Sulafat like the cut-paper family (owner decision: Fish Audio credits ran out before Arnold could be recorded); (c) survol-pixel (2026-11-18, same skill, style taken from a source pixel-art flight video), ranked with the others, voice-over Gemini Sulafat (owner decision 2026-11-18, API v1beta), blind visual judge on 6 identities during its review (survol-pixel + pixel-arcade, carte-meteo, topo-relief, pastel-diorama, trait-continu; 6/6 pure groups, 24/24 images, recognition.json blindJudgeSurvol); (d) lyrics-punchy and lyrics-chemin (2026-11-19), the two identities of the new content family `paroles` (muted lyric video, no voice-over), unranked, appended last, one proof short each rendered with filler lyrics (real lyrics and audio stay outside the repository); lyrics-chemin later got narrated and sung declinations, among them two « I Fold » shorts (2026-11-22) whose AI-generated song, sung on our filler lyrics, is baked into short.mp4
fieldNotes.voiceUsed: voice actually mixed into short.mp4 (Fish Audio Arnold for the 31 campaign shorts, Gemini Sulafat for the 8 cut-paper, 4 lot 2 and 2 survol-pixel shorts, i.e. 31 Arnold + 14 Sulafat; see shorts[].voiced)
